items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I sat next to – I had lunch with Cheney.

ctx.x: The bed of the Great Emancipator.

Right. She was second to Bob Hope in many times at the White House. I used to be in line to meet all the Presidents with her. When I’d come to Ronald Reagan, he’d look at me and say, “What? You again?” I sat next to – I had lunch with Cheney.

items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Before he was Vice President, years ago. I got to know all of the people at the White House

ctx.x: Before he was Vice President, years ago. I got to know all of the people at the White House, not only the dignitaries, but the people that worked at the White House. The waiters were all very special people.
Duke’s father used to be a butler at the White House.
